title: Indiana Man Stalked and Killed Ex-Wife in Broad Daylight
description:
Bodycam footage captures the moments surrounding a tragic incident at a gas station in Fishers, Indiana, involving a woman and her ex-husband. Authorities say the incident occurred around 5 p.m. on June 28, 2023, at a Speedway gas station and involved Kaylah Farmer, 33. Prior to the event, Joshua Farmer had reportedly faced several felony charges, including multiple allegations involving his family. Prosecutors later claimed that the incident may have been an attempt to prevent Kaylah from testifying in court. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
